name: ai-og-images
description: Dynamic Open Graph image generation using Cloudflare Workers AI for social sharing previews.

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Your Cloudflare account ID for Workers AI

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN
envVars.description: API token for Cloudflare Workers AI

ai.whenToUse: When the user wants dynamic, AI-generated Open Graph images for social sharing on blog posts, docs, or marketing pages.
ai.whenNotToUse: When the project uses static pre-made OG images, or for internal dashboards with no public sharing needs.
